owner: Government of South Sudan / Ministry of Information, Communication Technology and Postal Services; World Bank funding referenced
notes: WeAreTech reported an Oct. 2024 ministry announcement that World Bank funding had been secured for South Sudan's first resilient data center. Eye Radio reported on 2026-04-30 that the ICT minister said a national data center was being built and was halfway complete. Specific site and capacity were not published; classified to Central Equatoria because Juba is the seat of the ministry and the only location evidenced in related digital infrastructure coverage.
